payload.answer: Two distinct triggers, and they want the same mechanism. (1) SALVAGE: an autonomous session was going well and then took a wrong turn -- rewrote something it should not have, or chased a refactor nobody asked for. The work before that point is good and currently gets thrown away with the rest. (2) EXPLORATION: a deliberate A/B, running two approaches from one starting point and keeping the better. Trigger (1) is the one that recovers real money, since the alternative today is paying for the whole run again.
